Meta.title: I understand the assignment
Meta.description:
- Only do tasks that are shown as available to you. Do not go off on your own or you may trigger unintended events early, breaking the route.
- When a task is marked "Delay" it means there is a reason to save it, usually because it gives XP or inspiration that could be utilized later.
- This is a Dark Urge playthrough. Other origins will require significant adjustments and will not get as much XP.
- This is a "good-aligned" playthrough. DUrge is done with minimal kills, we recruit Will, we save Last Light. Some of these things result in less XP than is strictly possible.
- Certain items that tend to be used in a lot of builds are marked "Gear". Vendors are marked "vendor" and each vendor has a warning task to finish your business with them before they are KO/Killed. Some hard to find or out of the way items are also marked with tasks. Other than that, looting stuff is up to you.
